conn.title: Connection
conn.lead: The ports that agents and the Linager application connect to. A change takes effect at once, the server does not need a restart.
conn.fp.hint: The same for the agent port and the application port. The application remembers it on its first connection.
conn.agent.hint: Agents connect here directly over TLS. When the port changes, agents move to the new one by themselves and the old port stays open until all of them have moved.
conn.app.hint: The Linager application connects here over TLS. Empty: the port is off.
conn.firewall: Open the new port in the firewall of the server and the network.
conn.confirm.agent: Confirm: agent port {from} → {to}. Agents will move to the new port by themselves.
conn.blockers: These agents are online and cannot move to another port (version {min} or newer is needed). Update them, then the agent port can be changed:
conn.move.title: Agents are moving to the new port
conn.move.progress: From port {from} to port {to}: {moved} of {total} moved.
conn.move.offline: offline, will move when it connects
conn.move.old: old agent version, will not move by itself
conn.move.close.confirm: Close port {from}? Agents that did not move will lose their connection to the server.
conn.move.links: Install links and scripts made earlier contain the old port and will stop working.
conn.err.bad_port: A port is a number from 1 to 65535.
conn.err.port_conflict: The ports must differ from each other and from the admin panel port.
conn.err.port_in_use: The port is used by another program.
conn.err.agents_outdated: Some agents that are online cannot move to another port.
conn.err.move_active: Agents are still moving to the current port: wait for it to finish or close the old port.
conn.err.failed: The settings could not be applied.
